JOB 32:1.KJV: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
JOB 32:1.BHSA: וַֽיִּשְׁבְּת֡וּ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ֭אֵלֶּה מֵעֲנֹ֣ות אֶת־אִיֹּ֑וב כִּ֤י ה֖וּא צַדִּ֣יק בְּעֵינָֽיו׃ פ

JOB 32:2.KJV: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
JOB 32:2.BHSA: וַיִּ֤חַר אַ֨ף׀ אֱלִיה֣וּא בֶן־בַּרַכְאֵ֣ל הַבּוּזִי֮ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֢חַ֫ת רָ֥ם בְּ֭אִיֹּוב חָרָ֣ה אַפֹּ֑ו עַֽל־צַדְּקֹ֥ו נַ֝פְשֹׁ֗ו מֵאֱלֹהִֽים׃

JOB 32:3.KJV: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
JOB 32:3.BHSA: וּבִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת רֵעָיו֮ חָרָ֢ה אַ֫פֹּ֥ו עַ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־מָצְא֣וּ מַעֲנֶ֑ה וַ֝יַּרְשִׁ֗יעוּ אֶת־אִיֹּֽוב׃

JOB 32:4.KJV: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.
JOB 32:4.BHSA: וֶֽאֱלִיה֗וּ חִכָּ֣ה אֶת־אִ֭יֹּוב בִּדְבָרִ֑ים כִּ֤י זְֽקֵנִים־הֵ֖מָּה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ לְיָמִֽים׃

JOB 32:5.KJV: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.
JOB 32:5.BHSA: וַיַּ֤רְא אֱלִיה֗וּא כִּ֘י אֵ֤ין מַעֲנֶ֗ה בְּ֭פִי שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיִּ֥חַר אַפֹּֽו׃ פ

JOB 32:6.KJV: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
JOB 32:6.BHSA: וַיַּ֤עַן׀ אֱלִיה֖וּא בֶן־בַּֽרַכְאֵ֥ל הַבּוּזִ֗י וַיֹּ֫אמַ֥ר צָ֘עִ֤יר אֲנִ֣י לְ֭יָמִים וְאַתֶּ֣ם יְשִׁישִׁ֑ים עַל־כֵּ֖ן זָחַ֥לְתִּי וָֽאִירָ֓א׀ מֵחַוֹּ֖ת דֵּעִ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם׃

JOB 32:7.KJV: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
JOB 32:7.BHSA: אָ֭מַרְתִּי יָמִ֣ים יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝נִ֗ים יֹדִ֥יעוּ חָכְמָֽה׃

JOB 32:8.KJV: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
JOB 32:8.BHSA: אָ֭כֵן רֽוּחַ־הִ֣יא בֶאֱנֹ֑ושׁ וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּבִינֵֽם׃

JOB 32:9.KJV: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.

JOB 32:10.KJV: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
JOB 32:10.BHSA: לָכֵ֣ן אָ֭מַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָה־לִּ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵּעִ֣י אַף־אָֽנִי׃

JOB 32:11.KJV: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.
JOB 32:11.BHSA: הֵ֤ן הֹוחַ֨לְתִּי לְֽדִבְרֵיכֶ֗ם אָ֭זִין עַד־תְּב֥וּנֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם עַֽד־תַּחְקְר֥וּן מִלִּֽין׃

JOB 32:12.KJV: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:
JOB 32:12.BHSA: וְעָֽדֵיכֶ֗ם אֶתְבֹּ֫ונָ֥ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵ֣ין לְאִיֹּ֣וב מֹוכִ֑יחַ עֹונֶ֖ה אֲמָרָ֣יו מִכֶּֽם׃

JOB 32:13.KJV: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.
JOB 32:13.BHSA: פֶּן־תֹּ֣֭אמְרוּ מָצָ֣אנוּ חָכְמָ֑ה אֵ֖ל יִדְּפֶ֣נּוּ לֹא־אִֽישׁ׃

JOB 32:14.KJV: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
JOB 32:14.BHSA: וְלֹא־עָרַ֣ךְ אֵלַ֣י מִלִּ֑ין וּ֝בְאִמְרֵיכֶ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃

JOB 32:15.KJV: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
JOB 32:15.BHSA: חַ֭תּוּ לֹא־עָ֣נוּ עֹ֑וד הֶעְתִּ֖יקוּ מֵהֶ֣ם מִלִּֽים׃

JOB 32:16.KJV: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)
JOB 32:16.BHSA: וְ֭הֹוחַלְתִּי כִּי־לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ כִּ֥י עָ֝מְד֗וּ לֹא־עָ֥נוּ עֹֽוד׃

JOB 32:17.KJV: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
JOB 32:17.BHSA: אַעֲנֶ֣ה אַף־אֲנִ֣י חֶלְקִ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵעִ֣י אַף־אָֽנִי׃

JOB 32:18.KJV: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
JOB 32:18.BHSA: כִּ֭י מָלֵ֣תִי מִלִּ֑ים הֱ֝צִיקַ֗תְנִי ר֣וּחַ בִּטְנִֽי׃

JOB 32:19.KJV: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
JOB 32:19.BHSA: הִנֵּֽה־בִטְנִ֗י כְּיַ֥יִן לֹא־יִפָּתֵ֑חַ כְּאֹבֹ֥ות חֲ֝דָשִׁ֗ים יִבָּקֵֽעַ׃

JOB 32:20.KJV: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.

JOB 32:21.KJV: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
JOB 32:21.BHSA: אַל־נָ֭א אֶשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְאֶל־אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲכַנֶּֽה׃

JOB 32:22.KJV: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
JOB 32:22.BHSA: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֲכַנֶּ֑ה כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט יִשָּׂאֵ֥נִי עֹשֵֽׂנִי׃
